subject: English
question_text: Complete the text with suitable prepositions.
stimulus: The result of honesty is (a) ----- description. It results (b) ----- peace. On the other hand, misery results (c) ----- vice. So we should abstain (d) ----- evil deeds. Evil deeds bring (e) --- -- ruin.
guide_solution: Use of prepositions: (a) beyond/above; (b) in; (c) from; (d) from; (e) about.
